::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 12th 1900  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge XIII 2
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_133.qmd)
After having exhibited the mittens to various very respectful admirers and waiting in vain for my [Cousin](people/person_28.qmd) to come and see them last week I have decided on sending them to her registered and I am sure she will carefully return them in a short time with many many thanks for the privilege.

Yours thankfully
C.M. Yonge

---

**Note:** Envelope addressed  ‘Mrs Belfield/Malmain/French hay /Bristol and postmarked Winchester 12 February 1900.
